title: VietLyrics: A Large-Scale Dataset and Models for Vietnamese Automatic Lyrics Transcription

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the fine-tuned Automatic Lyrics Transcription (ALT) model's performance by comparing Word Error Rates (WER) across different predicted singer genders (male, female, and 'both').
